walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: Marketing and People — a core area of A-Level Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: Marketing and People brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: Marketing and People.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

BCG

Deloitte

mcqs.q: Selling new products to existing customers (Ansoff) is:
options: Market penetration
Market development
Product development
Diversification

mcqs.q: What three Ps are added to make the extended marketing mix (7Ps)?
options: The 7Ps are just the 4Ps repeated with different words.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
People (staff/service quality), Process (how the service is delivered), and Physical Evidence (tangible cues — uniforms, packaging, branding) — added to make the 4Ps relevant to services marketing.

mcqs.q: What is a brand in marketing?
options: A brand is just the logo on a product.
Mayo invented the assembly line.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
A combination of name, design, symbols and associations that distinguishes a product and creates customer perception and loyalty — more than just a logo.

mcqs.q: What did Mayo's Hawthorne studies suggest about motivation?
options: Mayo invented the assembly line.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
Mayo proved that better lighting increases productivity.

Workers are motivated by social factors and the feeling of being noticed/valued — not just pay or physical conditions. Productivity rose because researchers paid attention to workers, not because lighting improved.
